items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: the first shows I did the Steve Allen show, if they asked me to do the sketches they didn’t have teleprompters yet, they had cue cards.

ctx.x: No. Well now on the — the first shows I did the Steve Allen show, if they asked me to do the sketches they didn’t have teleprompters yet, they had cue cards. And what they would do is in rehearsal Steve Allen would forbid the use of the punch lines at rehearsals. So he’d do the joke: “Hey Fred, what time do you leave for the bank?” “I’m leaving for the bank but I have to go somewhere first.” “Where do you have to go?” “Rabadaza.” You weren’t allowed to read the punch lines. So when you did it that night on camera…
He was quite — you described him as very analytical and —
